I notice the precondition allows index to go one too far — it should require index to be at most the content length, not one more, since an index equal to length+1 would hit a null right child in a terminal node. The fix is to tighten the requires clause to `0 <= index <= |n.Contents|`.

As for categorizing this bug, I'm weighing whether it's "initiation" or "bridge" — the weak precondition fails to guarantee the facts needed for the internal recursive call's own precondition, so I'll classify it as initiation.
